name: Nubis
summary: A night-blue weather dashboard with a live rain radar, forecasts, air quality and an API
about: Nubis is a weather app and API service with sample data for cities across Pakistan. A hand-drawn radar map shows rain cells drifting with the wind under a sweeping beam, with a time bar to look back or ahead. It also has current conditions with animated sky icons, hourly and 10-day forecasts, saved places, alerts, air quality, climate history and API keys with billing.
how: Open Radar and watch the beam sweep while rain cells drift east
Drag the time bar or press Play to see the last two hours and the next hour
Turn map layers on and off: rain, clouds, wind arrows and temperature
Switch places from the header pills and flip between °C and °F
Create an alert rule, or dismiss a warning
Create or revoke an API key and change your plan
